entities.summary: Peter Wildoer (b. 1974-09-05, Helsingborg) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Helsingborg and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
